name: Plant-Based Wild Mushroom & Charred Onion Flour Tacos (Night 1)
whyItWorks: Soft flour tortillas are flare-friendly, but the filling of chewy wild mushrooms, charred onions, and pickled cabbage/lime is high-FODMAP.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If ordering tacos, ask the kitchen to fill the warm flour tortillas with plain shredded chicken or plain beef tenderloin strips instead of mushrooms and onions.
watchOuts: Wild mushroom mannitol and charred onion fructans
Raw cabbage slaw and lime squeeze
